bodyHtml:
🔧 Website Redesigns & Updates · Logan & Surrounds

Website Redesigns & Updates Logan. Make Your Site Work As Hard As You Do.

A tired, outdated website can hurt your credibility and drive potential customers away. Computer Repairs Logan offers professional website redesign and update services made especially for small businesses that want to stay competitive, modernising your site, improving its performance, and making it easier for visitors to take action.

Refresh My Website
✓ Content Preserved
✓ Mobile-First Rebuilds
✓ SEO Maintained Or Improved
✓ Full Backups Taken
Why It Matters

A Tired Website Costs You Customers.

A tired, outdated website can hurt your credibility and drive potential customers away. Whether your site is hard to navigate, slow to load, or simply doesn't reflect your current services, it's working against you instead of for you.

Our Approach

We Modernise It, Not Just Patch It.

Computer Repairs Logan offers professional website redesign and update services made especially for small businesses that want to stay competitive. We modernise your website, improve its performance, and make it easier for visitors to take action, so your online presence works as hard as you do.

What We Do

From A Simple Refresh To A Full Rebuild.

🖥️

Full Website Redesign

Modern, responsive design that looks great on phones, tablets and desktops, with updated branding and a clean, user-friendly layout.

⚙️

Technical Updates & Fixes

Fixing broken pages, slow load times, outdated plugins and compatibility issues, and improving speed, mobile responsiveness and functionality.

✍️

Content Overhaul

Rewriting or reorganising text to better communicate your services, updating bios, FAQs and product info, and adding new content sections or photo galleries.

🔍

SEO & Local Visibility

On-page SEO best practices, local keyword integration and structured data, and optimised page titles, meta tags, alt text and internal linking.

🔐

Security & Performance Upgrades

Adding SSL certificates and security patches, backup configuration and site recovery setup, and cleaner, more secure code to reduce vulnerabilities.

🛒

E-Commerce & Booking Add-Ons

Integration with Stripe, PayPal or Afterpay, plus WooCommerce or booking/scheduling tools if your redesign needs to sell or take bookings.

Before vs After

What A Proper Redesign Actually Changes.

Feature Before Redesign After Redesign
Page SpeedSlow loading, unoptimised imagesFast, with image and code optimisation
Mobile ResponsivenessPoor formatting on mobile devicesFully mobile-optimised and tested
Branding & Visual DesignOutdated layout, inconsistent coloursClean, modern design aligned with your branding
User ExperienceConfusing navigation, weak calls to actionIntuitive layout with clear CTAs
SEO StructureMissing meta tags, poor hierarchyOptimised content and search-friendly structure
Site MaintenanceHard to update, no backupsEasy-to-manage CMS with backup setup
Common Reasons To Redesign

Does This Sound Like Your Website?

  • It looks outdated. Or hasn't been touched in years.
  • It doesn't load well on mobile. Where most of your visitors are.
  • You've rebranded. And the site still shows the old look.
  • Customers can't find key info quickly. Like services or pricing.
  • You want better performance on Google. Or faster load speeds.
  • You're ready to add new content. Services, features or integrations.
Why Choose Computer Repairs Logan

We Focus On Function As Much As Form.

  • We understand small business. Tradespeople, consultants, retailers, family-run businesses.
  • Practical, results-focused work. Built to load fast, convert customers and rank on search engines.
  • Flexible, ongoing support. No long contracts if you just need a few updates later.
  • Communication without jargon. You'll always know what's being done and why.
Related Services

Pair Your Redesign With The Rest Of Your Online Presence.

Rather start completely fresh instead of redesigning? See our new website design service. Once your site is updated, our SEO services help people find it, and reliable web hosting keeps it fast and online.

Frequently Asked Questions

Your Questions, Answered.

How do I know if my website needs a redesign?

If your site is outdated, loads slowly, isn't mobile-friendly, or isn't generating leads, it's time to upgrade. We assess your website and recommend the right solution.

Can you redesign my WordPress site without losing my content?

Yes. We preserve your existing blog posts, service pages and contact forms while upgrading the design, theme and layout for better performance.

What platforms do you work with besides WordPress?

We redesign websites from Wix, Squarespace, Joomla, Weebly and others by rebuilding them on a faster, scalable platform like WordPress or a lightweight HTML template.

Can I keep my existing domain and email addresses?

Yes. Your domain name and email setup won't change, we'll update the hosting or connect the redesigned website to your current domain.

What happens to my SEO during a website update?

We maintain or improve your current SEO settings. That includes redirects, meta tags, page structure, and keeping your indexed content intact.

Is my website backed up during the redesign process?

Always. We take full backups before and after the redesign to protect your existing site and provide a fallback if needed.

Ready To Fix Your Slow, Clunky Website?

Request a free site review and we'll tell you honestly what needs fixing.

Refresh My Website
